works.body:
Hello! I love your style, and was wondering if you would be willing to draw my ghost girl character. 
ー
◦While she lived, she was a woman who reached the depths of spatial and temporal magics with her studies. However, her studies led her to knowledge no one should know. As a result, she lost her life. Her spirit was eventually resurrected by a druid, though her memory of her life was fractured. She now usually spends her days holed up in her manor's library, piecing her research back together, or lounging around drinking tea.
◦Even as a spirit, she experiences any range of expressions, though typically mild.
◦Motifs associated with her are locked doors, keys, books, sunflowers, and the concept of time (clockwork, hourglasses, etc.). 
ー
You're free to compose the image as you'd like, if that is okay. Thank you for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1v-gpPEfU53gvMw7CBf5rbd_ojSfStgZd?usp=sharing

(If needed) Short hairstyle character change:
Maybe an electric wave system? I've lost my sad expression and started to smile, and I'm completely immersed in my own world most of the time, and my personality has become very spontaneous!

I hope you'll reconsider, and please be kind!

How do you do?
I saw your illustration on the social networking service and fell in love with your color composition and the way you captured the shapes.

I would like to ask you to create an original character for a Cthulhu Mythos TRPG scenario called "Noguko" and "Yakushi".

The character in the red kimono is
A man about 175 cm tall.
A taciturn, always expressionless but sensitive child

The character wearing a white and green kimono is
a woman of 150 cm in height.
She is philanthropic and good at giving her own meaning to natural things. She is very expressive.

You may draw her as you like.
If possible, I would be very happy to see the atmosphere of blending into nature.

I would like to use it for personal use as a standby for my phone or as a Twitter header.

Thank you in advance.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-OUF-lC3b7BctsCI-UpiTgEIsvp5YNJ1

Hi Dr. Kikulak, nice to meet you!
I first saw your work on skeb and thought it was very nice.
I would love to work with you if it is convenient and under the right conditions.

Request details
I would like to create a character for a TRPG game.
I would appreciate it if you could draw an illustration of the two of us as a set with my friend's character (I have already obtained permission from my friend).
(I have already obtained permission from my friend.) Both characters are male and tall.
Both characters are male and tall, but you can deform them into a style that is easy and fun for Kikulak to draw. I was very attracted to Kikuraku's drawing style, so I would be happy if you could draw them as you like.

Profile]
(*Of course, you don't have to refer to it.)

Senior: A man wearing a mask.
Contrary to his appearance, he has a calm personality. He has an image of flowers scattered around him. Likes tea, embroidery, and music.

Juniors: Male with chestnut hair and red eyes.
Likes toys, animation and sweets. He has a personality that seems to believe in sexual goodness.

▼ If possible.
We are both good friends, so we would be happy if we seem to be close.

Thank you in advance.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Sk4cP_Q-r-kZgfWd35yMJT5YDTci5VRT?usp=sharing

Hello sensei, your works are amazing. I really love your art style and sense of coloring.

I want to request for an artwork of my original character to be printed for personal viewing purpose.

[Character information]
— This character is a lonely ghost that has troubles understanding human emotions. She is tasked to study and learn how to become a human. To blend in amongst normal human, she puts up a fake personality, often seen as a cheery and cute girl.
— The girl is also a collector. Her collection is filled with objects she deems valuable. In the reference folder, she is usually depicted in an art gallery/museum setting; however, this is not a real place. The gallery only exists in her head as a metaphor to her tendencies of observing others, objectifying, and placing them about under her sight, yet too afraid to interact.
— Please select one of the following designs for the artwork:
01: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-j1bqeTrl7HQW4DTFadBijhcIkBX8FW5
02: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/11BSCASplM7-E1CqHsIrCcf7BU044Dzby

[Request content]
— Please draw her with floating fish, or floating fish skeletons
— Other than that, please have fun with the artwork and draw however you like!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1-j1bqeTrl7HQW4DTFadBijhcIkBX8FW5
